ImageDescription.value: The Ibrahim-al-Ibrahim Mosque, also known as the King Fahd bin Abdulaziz al-Saud Mosque or the Mosque of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, is a mosque located at Europa Point in the British overseas territory of Gibraltar, a peninsula connected to southern Spain. The mosque faces south towards the Strait of Gibraltar and Morocco several miles away. Built in 1997, the Mosque caters for the Muslim population of Gibraltar, most of which originated from Morocco. This mosque may be visited at certain times of the day.
